newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - In Focus estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - In Focus estimates cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analysts Todd Bakar and Ian Morton have cut their third quarter earnings estimate for In Focus Systems Inc to $0.15 a share from $0.31.
-- In written research, the analysts cut the 1996 earnings estimate to $1.02/shr from $1.20 and 1997 to $1.90 from $2.00.

-- The move follows In Focus's announcement Monday that its third quarter earnings would fall below analysts's expectations due to insufficient supply of a key product, capital constraints and price competition.
-- The analysts said the move is already reflected in the company's stock price. It was unchanged at 14-1/2 by midday.
